caption.value: Metal greatshield depicting the Haligtree with unalloyed gold. Carried by knights who have vowed to serve Miquella's Haligtree. Possesses high holy damage negation. Yet now, with the Haligtree misshapen, this wondrous rendition is a fleeting fantasy.

description.value: Metal greatshield depicting the Haligtree with unalloyed gold. Carried by knights who have vowed to serve Miquella's Haligtree. Possesses high holy damage negation. Yet now, with the Haligtree misshapen, this wondrous rendition is a fleeting fantasy.

location.value: Has a 4% base chance to drop from one specific Haligtree Knight in the graveyard beside the church at the bottom of Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree . All other Haligtree Knights, regardless of if they wield this Shield, will not drop it. To reach the Knight, go to the Drainage Channel Site of Grace, head outside and follow the roots on your left. Drop down onto the first support beam (a flying buttress) that slopes down to the right. Halfway down the buttress, there is a branch to the left that you need to drop down to. Cross the branch and jump/fall onto another buttress. From here, you can fall to the ground directly while taking some fall damage, or jump to the church balcony first and drop from there. The knight can be found sitting underneath the buttress near its base. Alternatively, from the Haligtree Roots Site of Grace, turn around and go up the elevator. Once you reach the top, run straight until you're outside the Church. Then turn right, and right again once you get past the corner of the building to find the knight.

caption.value: Metal greatshield depicting the Haligtree with unalloyed gold. Carried by knights who have vowed to serve Miquella's Haligtree. Possesses high holy damage negation. Yet now, with the Haligtree misshapen, this wondrous rendition is a fleeting fantasy.

description.value: Metal greatshield depicting the Haligtree with unalloyed gold. Carried by knights who have vowed to serve Miquella's Haligtree. Possesses high holy damage negation. Yet now, with the Haligtree misshapen, this wondrous rendition is a fleeting fantasy.

location.value: Has a 4% base chance to drop from one specific Haligtree Knight in the graveyard beside the church at the bottom of Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree . All other Haligtree Knights, regardless of if they wield this Shield, will not drop it. To reach the Knight, go to the Drainage Channel Site of Grace, head outside and follow the roots on your left. Drop down onto the first support beam (a flying buttress) that slopes down to the right. Halfway down the buttress, there is a branch to the left that you need to drop down to. Cross the branch and jump/fall onto another buttress. From here, you can fall to the ground directly while taking some fall damage, or jump to the church balcony first and drop from there. The knight can be found sitting underneath the buttress near its base. Alternatively, from the Haligtree Roots Site of Grace, turn around and go up the elevator. Once you reach the top, run straight until you're outside the Church. Then turn right, and right again once you get past the corner of the building to find the knight.
